CustomField.description: IM-530: Field to store if edit actions are available o Budget. This field was created to reduce the filter conditions on buttons as the filter limit is 10
CustomField.formula: AND( $Permission.IM_Edit_Budget_Action_Access == true,OR(AND( Initiative__r.RecordType.Name == 'Amendment', NOT(Initiative__r.Approved__c)), AND( Initiative__r.RecordType.Name != 'Amendment', NOT( AND( NOT( Is_Active__c ) , Initiative__r.Approved__c) ) )))
CustomField.label: Is Action Available
